name: Kimpton Clocktower, Manchester
positioning: Kimpton Clocktower Hotel, a pet-friendly city-centre hotel behind a grand Victorian facade, steps from the Palace Theatre
best_for: Theatre and live-music visitors who want to be steps from the Palace Theatre
Guests who enjoy a lively bar and social hour

facts.text: The hotel is steps from the Palace Theatre.
The hotel has a grand Victorian facade.
The Refuge Bar & Restaurant serves small and large plates blending British ingredients with global influences.
The Refuge Public Bar makes cocktails with house-made vermouths and bespoke infusions.
Afternoon tea is served in the hotel's Winter Garden.
The Terrace is a courtyard with greenery, outdoor heaters and a canopy.
Premium rooms include a Nespresso coffee pod machine and complimentary turndown service.
The fitness centre has cardio machines, free weights and a Peloton bike.
The hotel runs a Social Hour with complimentary drinks for guests.
Pets are welcome at no extra charge, regardless of size or breed.

highlights.text: Suite No.51 has its own private entrance and a dedicated hotel ambassador.
The Duplex King Suite is a two-floor suite with a king bed and a separate living space.
Suite No.51 has a record player with its own private record collection.
The hotel offers a Music Concierge service for guests.

considerations.text: The hotel does not have a pool.
The hotel has no parking on-site; parking is available nearby from 20 pounds per day.
There is no local area shuttle at the hotel.
